groups.description: The Creation Care Ministry at Saint Mark's Cathedral strives to faithfully address the climate crisis through education, advocacy, and action. With a commitment to achieving net-zero carbon emissions on the cathedral campus by 2030, this ministry also lifts up the…

groups.name: Meal Sharing Ministry
groups.description: The Meal Sharing Ministry is committed to providing nutritious meals and warm hospitality to our fellow neighbors in Seattle who are homeless/hungry. We prepare and serve meals regularly for First Covenant Church Breakfast and St. Martin de Porres Men's Shelter.
